name: u39-share-link-metadata
about: Incremental share-record row sensitivity only. Current src/namespace/README.md reads/writes table and src/storage/s2h_resources.json @namespace/shares state one record per signed link; no network request occurs when signing locally. Five links/day and the 32-word metadata size are assumptions, not measured user behavior. This workload does NOT include find-file lookups, keys, canonical Namespace storage orders/totals, recipient GETs, range crossings, bytes served, egress or expiry removal; those are required separate meters. Do not interpret the metadata result as a complete share cost. The synthetic field is metadata, outside the candidate search field text, because a share receipt is not user-searchable prose; no artificial text postings are added.
